column1: # Canonical block_signatures_simplex_pq#13 carrier measurements; BOCs use mode 0.
# Counts through 100 use real verifier-valid ML-DSA-44 signatures. The 400 row uses
# distinct deterministic exact-width payloads; this saves 300 signing operations and
# changes no size because all signature objects remain exactly 2420 bytes.
# node_tl and lite_tl are measurements from the generated serializers. They are
# smaller than the retired projection by 4 * signers + 4 because TL writes a bare
# vector of bare concrete elements. This correction does not reopen the persisted
# envelope: its 1 MiB bound was selected from the #13 BOC plus BlockProof overhead,
# not from either TL column, and every corrected network value moved downward.
